name: application-video-thumbnail-card
title: Video Thumbnail Card
description: Video discovery card with thumbnail, duration badge, title, channel avatar/name, and a formatted view count — distinct from image-gallery-lightbox, which is a full-screen image viewer with navigation rather than a discovery/browse card.
useWhen: Building a video browse/discovery grid or feed.
You need view counts formatted at scale (K/M) rather than raw numbers.
Duration should be visible on the thumbnail without a player being active.
avoidWhen: You need a full-screen image or media viewer with next/prev navigation — use image-gallery-lightbox instead.
The video is already playing and mid-watch — use watch-progress-bar to show resume position instead.
You need active playback controls — use now-playing-bar instead.
responsiveBehavior: The thumbnail maintains a 16:9 aspect ratio via aspect-video; the title clamps to two lines and channel/view text truncates at narrow widths.
accessibility: The channel avatar placeholder is aria-hidden since the channel name is already available as text.
View counts are always rendered as readable text, never encoded only in a visual size or icon.
The duration badge has sufficient contrast against any thumbnail color via a semi-opaque black background.

variants.title: Video thumbnail card
variants.description: A video card with an 8:47 duration badge and a view count formatted from a real 1,240,000 to '1.2M views', on a light surface.
accessibility: Duration and view count are both computed/formatted from real numeric props, not hand-typed strings.

variants.title: Video thumbnail card (Dark)
variants.description: The same video card, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and avatar placeholder colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
